pages.title: Keybindings

pages.text: $(li)$(l)K$() or Esc: skip a spell cutscene (the spell still happens)$(li)$(l)U$() Throw the target of Object Levitation
In big modpacks several mods may want the same key. NeoForge gives a key press to only one of them, so a clash with Iron's cast key can stop spells from casting at all.

The first time you join a world, this mod moves any default key that clashes with Iron's cast, spell wheel or quick-cast keys, and any of its own keys that clash, to a free key, and tells you in chat what moved. Keys you set yourself are never changed. Delete $(o)config/frieren_arcana-keyfix.txt$() to run it again.
